text:
Mira Patel: Heads-up — the new per-query cost sparklines on the dashboard are dropping to 0 during canary windows. Looks like routing is switching to a fallback and the tile shows zero cost.
Sam Yang: @Mira can you point to which tile? marginal-cost or per-call breakdown?
Mira Patel: marginal-cost tile for routes with heavy prefetch. Happens when circuit-breaker routes to the cheaper model variant.
Leo Torres: I think the router marks those as `replayed` and our ingest strips unit_cost for replayed requests. That would zero out the marginal sum.
Nidhi Rao: Correct — replayed requests are currently filtered from billable tokens in econ-ingest because we wanted to avoid double-counting cache-prefetch. But that makes the dashboard misleading.
Sam Yang: We need to show amortized/cache-crediting rather than hide them. Product teams will get confused if cost disappears during rollouts. :eyes: 
Mira Patel: Proposal: add route_variant and effective_model_sku to econ_event v2, stop treating replayed as "not present" for dashboard aggregates; surface a sample_count column and sampling_rate in hover.
Leo Torres: Implementation note: ingestion schema bump + consumer changes. Consumers should compute cost = tokens * COALESCE(effective_unit_cost, unit_cost). That keeps back-compat.
Nidhi Rao: Agree. Also add a low-sample warning when sample_count < 100 in the selected range. UX can show: "Low sample — estimates may be noisy".
Sam Yang: Need rollout plan: proto bump -> consumers -> dashboard query change -> feature flag -> canary. Who owns each?
Mira Patel: I can take the dashboard query and UX changes, add the hover for sampling_rate and the low-sample banner.
Leo Torres: I'll own the proto and ingest change. Will open PR with proto diff today. ETA: proto PR today, consumer deploys by EOW.
Nidhi Rao: For cost correctness, ingestion should also emit credit_reason (e.g., "prefetch_hit", "router_fallback") so we can break down savings vs. routed-degradation in the UI.
Sam Yang: +1 on credit_reason. Also add a console toggle "Show cache-crediting" so teams can compare gross vs net costs.
Mira Patel: UX note: default to net cost but show a small link to "show breakdown" that expands model-level amortization.
Leo Torres: SQL sketch for dashboard update: ```SELECT route, route_variant, effective_model_sku, SUM(tokens * COALESCE(effective_unit_cost, unit_cost)) AS cost, SUM(tokens) AS tokens, AVG(sampling_rate) AS sampling_rate FROM econ_events WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end GROUP BY route, route_variant, effective_model_sku;```
Nidhi Rao: Consumers should also tag events with sampling_rate at emit time so aggregates are meaningful without needing heavy joins.
Sam Yang: Ops: need canary with feature-flag `econ_v2_route_variant`. @deploybot can we schedule canary windows after proto PR merges?
deploybot: deploybot: Canary job queued: cost-ingest-v2 -> cluster-3; will report back.
Mira Patel: Follow-ups: 1) Leo open proto PR and add migration notes; 2) Nidhi add consumer spec for credit_reason + sampling_rate; 3) Sam create product ticket for console toggle and copy for tooltip; 4) Mira implement dashboard SQL + low-sample UX.
Leo Torres: Will add PR link in the thread once ready.
Sam Yang: Thanks — let's avoid a surprise "zero cost" story for customers mid-rollout.
Mira Patel: Agreed. I'll start a mockup for the hover tooltip and the low-sample banner and post it here.
Nidhi Rao: One more ask: telemetry team, please keep raw events for 30 days during the rollout to verify reconciliations.
Leo Torres: Noted.
Mira Patel: OK folks, moving to action items.
Sam Yang: :thumbsup:
